descriptions.r03_c01: Gray-white stone bridge balustrade base and curved masonry arch occupy the upper and right portions, with one existing stone post body clipped by the top edge near the right, and the existing rail continuing through the top/right. Preserve the arch opening and every stone joint. Blue-turquoise water and existing bridge shadow fill the lower-left; a small existing rounded green canopy is clipped by the bottom edge. Retain only that clipped foliage, no new plants or posts.
descriptions.r03_c02: A gray-white bridge balustrade slopes from upper-left toward lower-right, with one existing square-capped inset-panel stone post near right-center and one smaller existing vertical rail support to its left. Cream deck paving with long diagonal joints occupies upper-right; gray curved masonry outer bridge wall fills lower-left with only a tiny blue-water wedge at the lower-left corner. Keep all post proportions, rail endpoints and paving joints; no new objects.
descriptions.r03_c03: Mostly broad warm ivory-cream bridge paving with sparse long diagonal stone joints. A clipped gray balustrade base and its existing diagonal shadow occupy upper-right; the existing descending pale stair tread/riser edges enter along lower-right, and a clipped near-side rail enters lower-left. Preserve these exact height transitions, joints and shadow endpoints; no plants, water, posts, decorations or new stairs beyond the shown continuation.
descriptions.r03_c04: Existing gray-white balustrade with two large square-capped inset-panel stone posts, one clipped at upper-center-left and the second at lower-right; parallel rail beams run diagonally between them. Existing broad pale stone descending steps fill lower-left. Blue river is clipped at top; the established brown tree base, roots and rounded green riverbank foliage occupy upper-right behind the rail. Keep posts, rails, stair count/width and vegetation footprint; add no objects.
